caption: The drawing depicts a single carved figure of a rooster, positioned in profile facing to the right. The rooster is rendered in a brown color with lighter and darker shading to indicate the texture and layering of its feathers. Its tail feathers are fanned out widely and form a semi-circular shape. The head features a red comb and wattle, and the beak is yellowish. The rooster stands on a brown base that suggests the ground or a pedestal. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. There is a faint signature in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Toy Rooster
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
